entries.short: Slang insult for a police officer. Cuno uses it on you constantly.
An RCM rank title. Harry is a 'lieutenant double-yefreitor'.
entries.details: RCM ranks combine an officer grade with extra 'yefreitor' grades. Nobody outside the force finds it easy to follow, which the game enjoys.
entries.inspiredBy: From the Russian 'yefreytor' (from German 'Gefreiter'), a junior military rank similar to lance corporal.

entries.short: Insult for someone who works while others are on strike, undermining the strike.
Strikers gathered at a workplace entrance to stop others from going in to work.
A Thought you can get: embracing life as a cop who lives like a homeless drifter.
A police district and its station. RCM precincts are numbered (Harry's is 41, Kim's is 57).
